thread:
pagerbot: AUTO-PAGE fired for inference-gateway - 5xx rate 12.4% over 5m (alert: gateway_5xx_rate). PD incident created: https://pd.example/incidents/INC-2026-4812 :rotating_light:
Sam Nguyen: acked, I'm on call. looking now. could someone drop basic scope? region/cluster?
pagerbot: region: eu-west1, cluster: inference-prod-eu, affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. error distribution: 502=72%, 504=18%, 500=10%. sample latency increased to 2.8s.
Sam Nguyen: thanks. Marta, you free to join? @Marta Li
Marta Li: on it. pinging SRE rotation. starting quick triage: checking recent deploys and pod restarts.
Alex R: I noticed a canary deploy at 10:07 UTC to inference-gw that rolled 5% traffic earlier. deploy-bot posted: `deploy inference-gateway v6.3.1 -> canary(5%)`
deploy-bot: Deploy v6.3.1 to inference-gateway started at 10:07 UTC, canary route applied.
Sam Nguyen: ok run quick checks: `kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide` and `kubectl -n inference logs -l app=inference-gateway --tail=100`
Marta Li: pasted pod list and grep of errors:
```
POD                                   READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
inference-gateway-5b7d9c6f7-2k9lq    2/2     Running   0          3h    node-eu-23
inference-gateway-5b7d9c6f7-8hfpt    1/2     CrashLoop 6          12m   node-eu-18
inference-gateway-canary-6c4k2       1/2     CrashLoop 4          20m   node-eu-22
```
```
ERROR  "KV cache miss handler" stack overflow
ERROR  "Model shard load timeout" 30s
WARN   socket write failed: EPIPE
```
Marta Li: crashloops align with canary pods. seems related to model shard timeouts.
Sam Nguyen: rolling back canary immediately. Alex, can you cut traffic back to stable?
Alex R: routing canary -> stable now via console, command: `redwood route set inference-gateway --weight stable=100 canary=0`
Alex R: done. also scaling up warm pool for stable nodes by +3 instances: `infractl pool scale inference-warmpool eu-west1 3`
Support Bot: Notifying top-3 affected customers (cust-alpha, cust-delta, cust-omega) via status page: https://status.redwood.example/incidents/2026-03-15-48
Marta Li: flushing KV caches and restarting the two crashloop pods: `kubectl delete pod inference-gateway-...` then pods started and passed readiness checks.
Sam Nguyen: monitoring error rate. running a quick kusto-like query for 5xx rate:
```
SELECT rate_5xx FROM metrics.gateway WHERE cluster='inference-prod-eu' SINCE 5m
=> [12.4, 9.8, 6.2, 2.1, 0.8]
```
Sam Nguyen: error rate trending down to 0.8% over last sample. good.
pagerbot: AUTO-PAGE condition cleared. alert resolved automatically at 10:17 UTC. PD incident auto-resolved pending manual close.
Marta Li: leaving notes: root cause appears to be a regresssion in v6.3.1 where cold model shard loads blocked event loop under certain memory conditions. canary triggered crashloops, spilling errors across gw. removing canary stopped new failures and warmpool scale+cache flush mitigated.
Alex R: I'll open a rollback PR and mark v6.3.1 as blocked for rollout, tagging @release-team.
Sam Nguyen: filing quick incident summary in #postmortems and assigning owners: detection rule tuning (Sam), deployment gating (Alex), runtime guardrails (Marta). Also support follow-up for customer comms.
Support Bot: customers notified: cust-omega (priority), cust-alpha, cust-delta. Slack thread for customer ops: #support-ops-4812.
Marta Li: recheck after 15m, if stable we can close PD and call this mitigated.
Sam Nguyen: thanks everyone. leaving a final note: `downtime impact: degraded responses for 5% of requests in eu-west1 for ~10m. no data loss. action items posted.` :thumbsup:
Alex R: adding instrumentation alert to warn on canary crashloop rate >2 within 10m.
Sam Nguyen: moving to follow-up. handing off to oncall-secondary @Marta Li for the rest of shift. ::hand::
pagerbot: Thread closed (auto) - please file postmortem when convenient.
